sources.title: OpenRouter exact V4 variant mapping
sources.evidence: Maps its DeepSeek V4 Pro 0423 label to deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro and explicitly identifies it as the original April 2026 release, separate from Pro 0813. Specifies text input/output only.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Preview Release, April 24, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated official announcement releases the Pro preview, its open weights and API; reports nominal 1.6T total/49B active, one-million-token context, and thinking/non-thinking modes.

sources.title: Pinned original DeepSeek-V4-Pro model card
sources.evidence: Names the model as the DeepSeek-V4 preview; identifies MoE, hybrid CSA/HCA attention and mHC. Reports nominal 1.6T/49B and 1M context, non-think/high/max modes, and explicitly applies MIT to repository and weights.

sources.title: Pinned DeepSeek-V4-Pro configuration
sources.evidence: Specifies DeepseekV4ForCausalLM, 61 main layers, hidden size 7168, 384 routed experts/top-6 plus one shared expert, one next-token prediction layer, FP4 experts, and max_position_embeddings=1048576.

sources.title: Official DeepSeek-V4-Pro inference implementation
sources.evidence: Defines the Transformer, MoE and MTP modules. Packed FP4 matrices have half-width storage; quantization scales are separate. Token-to-expert maps have requires_grad=False. mHC scales and gate biases are parameters; MTP shares main embedding/head.

sources.title: Official FP4 checkpoint conversion
sources.evidence: Unpacks the low/high nibbles of each I8 expert matrix element into two FP4 weights and applies separate block scales. Skips any shared MTP embedding/head duplicates.

sources.title: Pinned index and all 64 bounded safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Independently matched all 145116 indexed tensors to 64 shard headers. Raw 861608274846 elements include 786381668352 packed FP4 elements, 49150268416 quantization-scale elements and 2327040 fixed routing indices. Correct logical count is 1598837347742: main 1572997201763 plus unique MTP 25840145979. No MTP embedding/head duplicates occur.

sources.title: Original V4 text, reasoning and tool encoding
sources.evidence: Documents text conversation encoding and parsed text output, thinking/chat modes, reasoning blocks, DSML tool invocation and tool-result handling.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro MIT license
sources.evidence: Contains MIT license text; the matching model card explicitly applies this license to both code and model weights.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4 technical report
sources.evidence: The Pro-specific setup describes a 61-layer Transformer, 384 routed experts/top-6 with one shared expert, MTP depth one, hybrid attention and mHC. Reports nominal 1.6T total/49B active. FP4 QAT uses master weights, distinguishing logical weights from quantized storage scales.

sources.title: DeepSeek release and alias change log
sources.evidence: April 24 explicitly announces V4-Pro API availability. August 13 replaces the official deepseek-v4-pro API alias with its GA revision, so current official alias behavior must not be attributed to the 0423 checkpoint.

sources.title: Official checkpoint revision history
sources.evidence: History records Release DeepSeek-V4 on April 24 at revision 0e1a0e5e52aea73055f50fef6f2423db370265b6. The indexed tensor mapping and all 64 weight-file metadata entries at that release match the counted June 22 revision; later commits update supporting files.

patch.notes: 0423 identifies the original DeepSeek-V4-Pro preview, publicly released April 24, 2026; it is separate from the August 13 GA model. Complete logical checkpoint total is 1598.837347742B: 1572.997201763B main plus 25.840145979B unique MTP. Count expands packed FP4 weights and excludes quantization scales/fixed routing indices while retaining learned mHC scales and parameterized gate biases. Shared embedding/head counted once. DeepSeek reports nominal 1.6T total and 49B active; active figure describes main-model inference rather than combined MTP drafting. Advertised context is 1M; configured positional ceiling is 1048576. The official deepseek-v4-pro API alias was upgraded to GA on August 13, so it no longer establishes this dated preview identity. No endpoint execution was tested.

summary: Verified all 14 fields for the original 0423-labeled Pro preview. Corrected public release date to April 24; added MIT, MoE, complete 1598.837347742B parameters and nominal 49B active. Independently counted all shard headers with FP4/metadata handling and verified release-weight continuity. Preserved advertised 1M text context, reasoning/tools and supported description; distinguished later GA alias behavior.
